name: lib/rng
title: RNG
summary: Injected randomness: the Random interface and Mulberry32, the seeded generator every build reproduces bit for bit, plus integer probability thresholds. Retry jitter and the N8 chaos engine draw from it; no core reads ambient randomness.

ts.name: mathRandom
ts.summary: Unseeded Math.random-backed Random, for production jitter only.

ts.name: hits
ts.summary: Whether a draw hits probability p (p = 1 always).

rs.name: hits
rs.summary: Whether a draw hits probability p.

behaviour.rule: next = mulberry32 exactly as the spec writes it: state += 0x6D2B79F5 (mod 2^32); t = imul(t ^ t>>>15, t|1); t = (t + imul(t ^ t>>>7, t|61)) ^ t; return (t ^ t>>>14) >>> 0.
The first 8 outputs for seeds 0, 1, 42 and 4294967295 equal prng.cases.json in every build.
A probability p in [0, 1] becomes floor(p * 2^32); a draw u hits when u < threshold; p = 1 always hits; p outside [0, 1] or not finite is rejected.
No core reads ambient randomness; tests and chaos use Mulberry32.

gaps: Python lands in phase 2 (mzizi-registry#472): a .py sibling, the /v1/py/{name} route in mzizi-api-gateway and a PyPI package.
